content: {"a_point": "When a notice under Art. 257d CO clearly specifies the overdue rent and threatens termination for non-payment, it is valid even if it includes non-applicable additional charges, provided the amount due for rent is clearly set out in a separate paragraph in bold type.", "b_propositions": [{"a_id": "S8", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "answer"}, {"a_id": "S14", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}, {"a_id": "S16", "b_speaker": "court", "c_slot": "rule"}]}
